brief:
Israeli operations in Gaza have killed 73,388 people and wounded 174,259 others since October 7, 2023, according to medical sources cited by Shehab Wire. The toll represents a cumulative count spanning more than a year of conflict in the densely populated enclave.

One death and two injuries were recorded over the past 24-hour period, medical sources reported. Gaza's hospitals received the casualties during the reporting window, adding to the strain on healthcare infrastructure already overwhelmed by the sustained military campaign.
